clips.title: The story
paras: In Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon fights to save his gravely ill daughter, Relara. He turns to the local herbalist Orendil Broadleaf and Alliance travelers for help, seeking sacred remedies in Ashenvale.

Pelturas Whitemoon lives in Astranaar with his young daughter, Relara. They often gather moonstones together at Fallen Sky Lake. When Relara falls critically ill with a mysterious affliction, Pelturas turns from their quiet days to the urgent work of saving her. Though Astranaar faces dangers on many fronts, his daughter is all that matters to him.
